# No scorpions when the sky rule is none
zin_default_production_no_skies = {
	allowed = {
		always = yes
	}
	enable = {
		NOT = { zin_rules_skies_present = yes }
	}
	abort_when_not_enabled = yes
	ai_strategy = {
		type = equipment_production_factor
		id = anti_air
		value = -100
	}
}

# One line of pack trains once the realm has twelve armouries
zin_default_production_pack_trains = {
	allowed = {
		always = yes
	}
	enable = {
		num_of_military_factories > 11
	}
	abort_when_not_enabled = yes
	ai_strategy = {
		type = equipment_production_min_factories_archetype
		id = motorized_equipment
		value = 1
	}
}
